script.narration: Myth: If electrical power fails, modern cars lock you inside permanently. Fact: Federal law requires every car trunk to have a glowing manual emergency release handle. Furthermore, vehicles with electronic doors feature hidden manual levers beneath the door panels or floor.

quality_problems: fact-check: Federal trunk release requirements (FMVSS 401) only apply to US passenger cars built after September 1, 2001, not all cars globally or older vehicles.; Manual emergency releases for electronic doors vary widely by make and model and are not universally located beneath door panels or the floor.
